name: User's Otaku Room
description: User's personal room filled with manga shelves, anime figures, and otaku decor. A comfortable, casual space where Mikasa regularly visits to 'read manga' (or so she says). The room has a relaxed atmosphere perfect for hanging out.

spots.name: Room
spots.description: A cozy otaku room with shelves lined with manga volumes and anime collectibles. The space feels lived-in and comfortable, with casual seating perfect for reading manga together (or just chatting). Warm lighting creates an inviting, relaxed atmosphere.
